description: Searches iEscrow's public catalog of physical products and services sold for crypto, with the seller's REAL reputation on each result (identity verified, completed trades, success and dispute rates, star rating). No account needed. Filter by text, price range in USD, category, condition, country it ships to, and minimum seller reputation. Each result has price_usd (the item), shipping_usd (charged per unit; 0 means shipping is included in the price) and total_usd (what the buyer pays per unit): compare offers by total_usd. Each result carries two different clocks: ships_within_days is how long the seller has to hand the parcel to the courier (miss it and the buyer is refunded automatically) and delivery_days is how long it then takes to arrive. Each result has `url`, the page on iescrow.io where a person buys it: the buyer's crypto is held by iEscrow and released only when the buyer confirms delivery. Empty results mean nobody is selling that right now; never invent listings.

category.description: One of the categories returned in `categories`

condition.description: Products only, best to worst: new (sealed), like_new, open_box, refurbished, used

identity_verified_only.description: Only sellers with verified identity (KYC). Recommended for anything over a few hundred dollars.

max_price_usd.description: Upper bound of the TOTAL per unit (price plus shipping)

min_completed_trades.description: Minimum completed trades of the seller

min_price_usd.description: Lower bound of the TOTAL per unit (price plus shipping)

min_rating.description: Minimum average star rating of the seller (sellers with no ratings yet are excluded)

offset.description: Skip this many results, to page through a total bigger than limit

ships_to.description: ISO-2 country the buyer is in, e.g. AR, US. Products that ship worldwide always match.

sort.description: Default newest. price_asc and price_desc order by the TOTAL per unit (price plus shipping). 'reputation' puts verified sellers with the most completed trades first.
